metadata.weights: Kimi-K3-w4a8-mxfp-quarot; routed experts MXFP4 group32 (0.5 B/element + E8M0 group-32 scales) with dynamic int8 activations (W4A8); dense attention, shared experts, dense MLP and LM head BF16; catalog mxfp4_routed_only
metadata.fabric: intra-host UB_MESH 392 GB/s per 8-die host; inter-host 4 x 400G RoCE declared as one 200 GB/s aggregate switched link
metadata.mtp: none: speculative_config=None in the measured serve log
metadata.profile: msprof rank0/TP0 p32768 o64: KDA 12.29%, MLA 4.62%, MoE GEMM 20.6%, other GEMM/quant 22.2%, TP/EP collectives 14.3%, alltoallv 46% of collectives
metadata.measured_profile: examples/artifacts/a5-kimi-k3-longctx.json (schema a5-kimi-k3-profile-rows/1; bound only through run_k3_a5_cells.py --k3-profile, never auto-applied)
metadata.mte_bw_basis: a5_fleet_1x_hbm: every other A5 case declares 4.0e12; the 8.0e12 value is the a3_types SKU-profile default 2*hbm_bw, which is only validated for A3 (2400 = 2*1200), so it is not kept
metadata.mte_bw_alternate_source: a3_types MachineSpec._from_profile default mte_bw_bytes_per_s = 2*hbm_bw (no measurement in this case)
metadata.mte1_basis: Inherit Ascend950DT_9582 arch3510 profile: one shared PIPE_MTE1 at 256 B/cycle/AIC * 32 AIC * 1.65 GHz = 13.5168 TB/s. The former 4 TB/s override copied the off-chip transfer declaration without an independent L1-to-L0 basis. Same-campaign npu-smi confirms Ascend950DT/96 GiB; the 9582 suffix and nominal clock remain declared profile assumptions.

machine.name: a3-9362-8die-tp8
machine.note: one A3 host (192.168.13.165), 4 two-die packages = 8 dies, dies 8-15 exposed, one rank per die; default transfer channels materialize 4 SIO intra-package links at 448 GB/s and one 8-die HCCS_SW intra-node link at 196 GB/s

metadata.recipe: vllm serve /mnt/weight/GLM-5.3-W4A8-INT --served-model-name glm53-w4a8 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18236 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --distributed-executor-backend mp --quantization ascend --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 73728 --max-num-seqs 16 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.97 --enable-chunked-prefill --no-enable-prefix-caching --model-loader-extra-config '{"enable_multithread_load": true, "num_threads": 128}'
metadata.weights: GLM-5.3-W4A8-INT (378 GiB, 99 shards); 78 body layers, hidden 6144, 256 routed experts top-8 + 1 shared, MLA kv_lora_rank 512 / q_lora_rank 2048, qk 192+64 rope, v 256, DSA index_topk 2048, vocab 154 880; measured per-rank weight load 49.6497 GB (x8 = 397 GB); W4A8_DYNAMIC routed experts + W8A8_DYNAMIC attention/shared/dense + FLOAT norms/gates/embedding/LM head; served expert layout is TP8 (expert_parallel 1): 256 expert groups resident on every rank at 1/8 intermediate width (gate/up n=512, down k=256 per rank), 45.30 GB of expert weights per rank, zero dispatch/combine/all-to-all kernels
metadata.host: 192.168.13.165 (A3, openEuler), 8 NPU packages x 2 dies = 16 dies of 65 536 MB; only dies 8-15 exposed to torch as ranks 0-7
metadata.fabric: 4 SIO intra-package die pairs (448 GB/s, direct) + one 8-die HCCS_SW switched intra-node fabric (196 GB/s declared default); TP8 all-reduce spans four packages (measured 8-rank hcom_allReduce: attention alpha 24.75 us / 93.66 GB/s payload, expert-MLP alpha 31.37 us / 101.90 GB/s payload); the served trace carries 157 all-reduces per forward and zero all-to-all
metadata.mtp: none: speculative_config=None in the measured serve log; the checkpoint's one num_nextn_predict_layers layer is loaded but never run, so one token per sequence per step
metadata.reduced_config_reason: the briefed 131 072 @ gmu 0.90 recipe fails engine init on 64 GiB dies (11.62 GiB KV needed vs 3.68 GiB available; estimated max model length 41 472). The measured recipe is max-model-len 73 728 @ gmu 0.97 (KV 7.98 GiB / 89 856 tokens / 1.22x). Every measured cell is reduced_config and the 126 976 row cannot exist at this max_model_len.
metadata.unsupported_context: 131072 (and any prompt+output above 73728) is unsupported on this TP8/64 GiB configuration; it is refused, never extrapolated
metadata.row_policy: measured rows are declared by the cells manifest and applied only when their exact hardware/geometry matches; a foreign-hardware or foreign-shape row is declared missing, never substituted
metadata.expert_parallel: the served recipe does not pass --enable-expert-parallel: the trace shows 256 expert groups resident on every rank at 1/8 intermediate width and zero dispatch/combine/all-to-all kernels, so the case declares ep=1 (TP8 expert sharding). The EP8 32-local-expert layout in the original case was a modeling error; an EP8 dispatch/combine row was never measured and is declared missing.
metadata.graph: cudagraph_mode=FULL_AND_PIECEWISE (decode-FULL + piecewise prefill); cudagraph_capture_sizes=[1,2,4,8,16]; Graph capturing finished in 18 secs, took 0.21 GiB; no --compilation-config flag was passed, this is the image default
